confirmed_difference.summary: The current source cast each Object[] configuration value to String[] before checking whether it was an Integer or String. The original performs instanceof on the actual Object first. Normal Integer coordinates or String mode values therefore threw ClassCastException in the previous source before reaching the intended type checks.
confirmed_difference.result: Source now retains values as Object until the original instanceof guard. Invalid/missing coordinates follow the existing null/Unit early-return path; option is cast to String only after its String guard. No String[] checkcast remains in the method.
